Class TowerBurstEffect

java.lang.Object
models.base.TowerBurstEffect
public class TowerBurstEffect extends Object
A five-frame burst visual effect played at the moment a tower is destroyed.

Unlike ExplosionEffect, the burst uses a shared static sprite array so the images are loaded only once regardless of how many bursts fire. Each instance advances independently using a game-loop tick counter.
